interpretation: At most 0.0155 mm vertex displacement in the retained source-wall fragments and 0.0069 mm in retained spandrel fragments. The pairwise bound is a numeric upper bound if two originally coincident points quantize independently, not a measured whole-assembly seam width. Identical input coordinates quantize identically. This does not establish global watertightness or certify sub-mm architectural alignment.
weld_distinction: The separate 0.1 mm welded-topology test is an edge-count test. It is not a numerical seam bound and not a Boolean-union/collision certificate.
